objective: Preserve a separate no-execution scope, dependency, and gate disposition for seven conversion, OCR, and PDF/A PoCs; this packet is neither execution authority nor vendor selection.

approvalIsolation.rule: Each listed PoC requires its own exact scope, candidate/version, license/cost, security, corpus, oracle, environment, measurement, evidence, reviewer, and human execution authorization.

commonDecisionGates.requiredEvidence: Exact per-PoC candidate/product/runtime/model identity, version/build, source, digest, dependency graph, platform support, maintenance and removal path.
Exact synthetic or approved corpus, manifest/digest/classification, expected properties, independent oracle, quality method and approved numeric targets.
Exact license text and obligations, internal-evaluation and redistribution/runtime/support boundary, SBOM, advisory review and zero-additional-cost disposition.
Threat-boundary review, deny rules, malicious corpus plan, least-privilege isolation, no-hidden-upload proof, stop authority and independent result review.
Exact environment, network mode, resource safety ceilings, instrumentation, repetitions, run/evidence root, access, sanitization, retention, expiry and disposal.
Explicit authorization bound to exact PoC, candidate/version/digest, feature scope, environment, corpus/oracle, experiments, safety ceilings, stop rules and expiry.

pocRecords.objective: Prove Office to PDF capability for Word, Excel, and PowerPoint without selecting a permanent provider.

currentState.planningNote: Future Wave 1 candidate only after separate admission and authority.

oracleNeeds: Synthetic DOCX/PPTX/XLSX corpus covering fonts, tables, charts, formulas, pagination, print areas, sheet selection and slide order.
Independent visual and structural comparison that does not trust the converter output alone.
Per-format fidelity and limitation record, including missing-font and unsupported-object behavior.
Reopen, type, page/slide/sheet provenance and final-output validation.
resourceNeeds: Measured CPU, RAM, child processes, handles/threads, disk/temp/output size and stage duration on the frozen environment.
Control, typical, large-supported, policy-boundary, over-limit and adversarial-valid bands without invented numeric thresholds.
Single and bounded-concurrency runs with responsiveness, residual growth and cleanup evidence.
failureNeeds: Cancel, timeout, provider crash, invalid container, unsupported object, missing font, write/finalization denial and resource exhaustion.
No false success, late publication, partial final, source mutation, uncontrolled retry, orphan temp or unbounded child process.
Stable per-format limitation/fallback outcome; failure must not activate desktop Office automation or a server/public route silently.
prerequisites: P2-D01 approved for the exact Office conversion candidate/version/digest and platform/runtime.
P2-D02 approved for passive synthetic Office corpus, visual/structural oracle and quality/resource method.
P2-D03 approved with explicit zero-additional-cost, license, redistribution/runtime/support and SBOM/advisory disposition.
Security approval of macro/link/network denial and isolated headless behavior.
Per-PoC environment/evidence freeze and separate human execution authorization.
reopenConditions: A governed Phase 2 task explicitly schedules POC-CONV-001.
All prerequisites are complete and hash-bound to the same candidate, environment and corpus.
No paid component, Office license entitlement, support or infrastructure assumption remains unresolved.
An explicit, unexpired human execution authorization is recorded for this PoC only.

pocRecords.objective: Prove PDF to Word, Excel, and PowerPoint capability with target-specific editability and fidelity limitations.

currentState.planningNote: A prior governed-defer recommendation is not a human decision.

oracleNeeds: Native, scanned and mixed PDF corpus with text, layout, tables, images, reading order and unsupported structures.
Independent semantic, layout and editability oracle reported separately for DOCX, XLSX and PPTX.
Spreadsheet-cell oracle proving dangerous formula prefixes and external links are neutralized or safely rejected.
Reopen, type, content provenance, source digest and final-output validation.
resourceNeeds: Measured CPU, RAM, child processes, handles/threads, disk/temp/output and duration for native, scanned, mixed, large and complex inputs.
Single and bounded-concurrency behavior, including OCR-dependent routes if separately authorized.
No numeric performance or fidelity PASS until targets are approved.
failureNeeds: Cancel, timeout, provider crash, malformed/encrypted input, unsupported layout, write/finalization denial and resource exhaustion.
Target-specific safe failure/limitation instead of fabricated editable content or silent raster-only success.
No false success, hidden upload, public fallback, source mutation, partial final or orphan temp.
prerequisites: P2-D01 approved for the exact PDF-to-Office candidate/version/digest and three target scopes.
P2-D02 approved for native/scanned/mixed corpus and per-target semantic/layout/editability oracle.
P2-D03 approved with zero-additional-cost and exact license/runtime/redistribution/support evidence.
Security approval for malicious-PDF handling, hidden-upload denial and generated spreadsheet formula safety.
Per-PoC environment/evidence freeze and separate human execution authorization.
reopenConditions: Product Owner resolves whether the three output targets are Release-1 scope or governed defer.
A governed Phase 2 task explicitly schedules the exact approved target subset.
All prerequisites are complete and bind one candidate/configuration to one corpus/oracle revision.
An explicit, unexpired human execution authorization is recorded for POC-CONV-002 only.

pocRecords.objective: Prove local-first Indonesian, English, mixed-language and searchable-PDF OCR for the declared basic OCR scope.

currentState.planningNote: Future Wave 1 candidate only after local engine/language asset admission.

oracleNeeds: Synthetic Indonesian, English and mixed-language corpus with rotation, noise, scan quality, page selection and known expected text/fields.
Independent character, word and field metric implementation with approved normalization and numeric targets.
Searchable-PDF oracle for page/language selection, text-layer presence, reading order and reopen behavior.
Accuracy/confidence and limitation report that does not place full OCR text in ordinary evidence.
resourceNeeds: Exact engine and language asset/model size plus package/storage footprint.
Measured pages, pixels/resolution, CPU, RAM, temp/output, duration, handles/threads and residual growth.
Control through approved boundary bands, multi-page/batch and bounded concurrency without invented thresholds.
failureNeeds: Cancel, timeout, engine crash, corrupt/adversarial image or PDF, unsupported language, low-confidence result, insufficient memory/storage and output validation failure.
No false searchability/accuracy success, hidden upload, public AI fallback, content logging, partial final or source mutation.
Checkpoint/retry only if separately designed and bound to matching engine/input/config; otherwise safe rerun from source.
prerequisites: P2-D01 approved for exact local OCR engine/version/digest and Indonesian/English language assets.
P2-D02 approved for the ID/EN/mixed corpus, metric normalization, thresholds and privacy-safe evidence method.
P2-D03 approved for engine/language-data license, redistribution, runtime, update, support and zero cost.
Security approval for no public AI/upload, content exclusion, malicious input and isolated resource limits.
Per-PoC environment/evidence freeze and separate human execution authorization.
reopenConditions: A governed Phase 2 task explicitly schedules POC-OCR-001 and declares its basic OCR feature subset.
Exact language assets and offline behavior are admitted without paid or public-service assumptions.
Accuracy/resource methodology and evidence sanitization are independently reviewable.
An explicit, unexpired human execution authorization is recorded for POC-OCR-001 only.

pocRecords.objective: Prove complex-table, form and mixed-layout OCR structure fidelity without broadening basic OCR silently.
pocRecords.phaseGate: Table-heavy OCR, Markdown and Excel routes

currentState.planningNote: A prior governed-defer recommendation is not a human decision; basic-table versus complex-layout scope remains unresolved.

oracleNeeds: Synthetic complex-table corpus with merged cells, repeated and nested headers, multi-page tables, forms, mixed layouts, empty cells and reading-order markers.
Independent row/column/cell-span/header/page-continuation/form-field structure oracle.
Safe spreadsheet/CSV-cell oracle that proves formula-like values are neutralized or rejected without corrupting ordinary text.
Separate limitation result for downstream Excel/CSV/Markdown routes; those routes are not approved automatically.
resourceNeeds: Measured page, pixel, table, row, column, cell and layout complexity with CPU, RAM, temp/output and duration.
Large/multi-page tables, bounded concurrency, child-process/handle/thread use and post-run residual growth.
No numeric accuracy/resource PASS before exact target and safety ceiling approval.
failureNeeds: Cancel, timeout, engine crash, malformed/adversarial input, unsupported layout, ambiguous spans/headers, low confidence, output limit and formula-safety failure.
Preserve cell text as untrusted data while failing safely on structure; never emit active formula/link/macro side effects.
No false fidelity success, hidden upload, public fallback, partial final, source mutation or orphan temp.
prerequisites: Product Owner decides basic-table MVP versus complex-layout Release-1 scope.
P2-D01 approved for exact complex OCR candidate/version/digest and declared output routes.
P2-D02 approved for complex-table corpus, structural oracle, formula-safety oracle and thresholds.
P2-D03 and Security Reviewer approve exact engine/assets/license/cost and isolated formula/link/macro controls.
Per-PoC environment/evidence freeze and separate human execution authorization.
reopenConditions: The basic versus complex table/layout scope has a governed Product decision.
A governed Phase 2 task schedules the exact direct feature subset and downstream routes are separately gated.
All candidate/corpus/oracle/security/resource prerequisites are hash-bound and zero-cost.
An explicit, unexpired human execution authorization is recorded for POC-OCR-002 only.

pocRecords.objective: Prove safe PDF rendering from validated local or captured HTML artifacts; arbitrary remote URL fetching is excluded.

currentState.planningNote: Only a future captured/local-artifact scope may be proposed; current execution contract has no arbitrary URL input.

oracleNeeds: Synthetic local/captured HTML, CSS, embedded font/image and layout corpus with declared resource provenance.
Independent render comparison for layout, pagination, fonts, CSS and stable visible content.
Negative oracle proving script, navigation, downloads, local/custom schemes, WebSocket and every external network request are denied.
SSRF canaries for loopback, link-local, private/internal/metadata targets, redirects and ambiguous hosts remain denied without fetching them.
resourceNeeds: Measured CPU, RAM, child processes, handles/threads, nested-resource count, disk/temp/output and stage duration.
Large page, deeply nested layout, adversarial-valid input, bounded concurrency, timeout and post-run residual growth.
No numeric fidelity/resource PASS before targets and safety ceilings are approved.
failureNeeds: Cancel, timeout, renderer crash, malformed HTML/CSS/font/image, resource-limit breach, blocked scheme/fetch/navigation and output/finalization failure.
Any denied or inconclusive active/network behavior fails closed with no final output.
No hidden upload, network fallback, partial final, source mutation, persistent browser state or orphan process/temp.
prerequisites: P2-D01 approved for exact renderer/runtime/version/digest and local/captured-only capability.
P2-D02 approved for inert HTML corpus, independent rendering oracle and deny canaries.
P2-D03 approved with exact renderer/runtime/native/font license, patching, redistribution/support and zero cost.
Security approval for renderer isolation and total active-content/network/SSRF denial.
Per-PoC environment/evidence freeze and separate human execution authorization.
reopenConditions: The canonical HTML-to-PDF risk mismatch BASE-OI-008 is dispositioned or Medium controls remain mandatory.
The task scope remains local/captured-only; any remote fetch requires a separate controlled API/security addendum and new PoC authority.
All renderer/corpus/oracle/security/resource prerequisites are hash-bound and zero-cost.
An explicit, unexpired human execution authorization is recorded for POC-CONV-003 only.

pocRecords.objective: Prove conversion to explicitly declared PDF/A level or levels and conformance using an independent validator.

currentState.planningNote: POC-PDF-001 is Merge-only and cannot approve PDF/A conversion, conformance or validator choice.

oracleNeeds: Product-approved exact PDF/A level or levels with synthetic valid, invalid and repairable fixtures.
Independent conformance validator with exact product/version/source/digest and a different implementation trust path from the converter.
Validation of fonts, embedding, color profiles, metadata, attachments, forms/actions and signature handling for the declared level.
Negative fixtures proving converter success alone, invalid conformance, validator error or inconclusive result cannot publish final output.
resourceNeeds: Measured converter and independent-validator CPU, RAM, child processes, handles/threads, disk/temp/output and stage durations separately.
Control, typical, large-supported, invalid, repairable, policy-boundary and over-limit cases with bounded concurrency.
No numeric resource or conformance PASS before environment, target levels and policy thresholds are approved.
failureNeeds: Cancel, timeout, converter crash, validator crash/unavailable/inconclusive, invalid input, unsupported object/font/profile, output validation and finalization failure.
Validator unavailable/inconclusive is blocked or failed, never conformance success.
No partial final, silent repair claim, source mutation, hidden upload/network fallback or orphan temp.
prerequisites: Product + QA approve exact PDF/A level or levels and acceptable repair/limitation semantics.
P2-D01 separately approves exact converter and independent validator identities, versions and digests.
P2-D02 approves PDF/A corpus, independent conformance oracle, invalid cases and long-term compatibility claims allowed.
P2-D03 and Security Reviewer approve both tools, licenses, runtime/redistribution/support, advisories and zero cost.
Per-PoC environment/evidence freeze and separate human execution authorization.
reopenConditions: Exact PDF/A levels and validation authority are decided without assuming all levels.
Converter and independent validator are both admitted and hash-bound, with no self-validation-only oracle.
All corpus/security/resource/evidence prerequisites are complete and zero-cost.
An explicit, unexpired human execution authorization is recorded for POC-PDF-003 only.

pocRecords.objective: Prove PDF to Markdown using deterministic text/layout extraction first and separately governed OCR fallback only when needed.

currentState.planningNote: Future Wave 2 only; OCR/AI fallback does not become authorized through this record.

oracleNeeds: Native, scanned, table and multi-column PDF corpus with expected headings, lists, tables, reading order, page provenance and inert links/text.
Independent Markdown structure oracle; visual similarity alone is insufficient.
Separate deterministic-path and OCR-fallback results, each with exact provenance and limitations.
Sanitization oracle proving raw HTML, auto-fetch, formula-like text, active links and document instructions remain inert data.
resourceNeeds: Measured CPU, RAM, disk/temp/output, duration, child processes and residual growth for deterministic and authorized OCR routes separately.
Large/multi-column/table/scanned inputs, bounded concurrency and fallback-rate measurement.
No numeric fidelity/resource PASS before exact targets and safety ceilings are approved.
failureNeeds: Cancel, timeout, parser/OCR crash, malformed/encrypted input, unsupported layout, unsafe Markdown output, OCR unavailable and finalization failure.
No silent OCR/AI/public/provider fallback, false structure success, active output side effect, partial final or source mutation.
A failed deterministic path produces a governed limitation/fallback decision, not automatic content transfer.
prerequisites: P2-D01 approves exact deterministic extractor; any OCR fallback must also have a separately approved POC-OCR disposition and exact engine/assets.
P2-D02 approves the Markdown structure corpus/oracle, sanitization oracle and fidelity/resource targets.
P2-D03 approves all extractor/OCR dependencies, licenses, redistribution/runtime/support and zero cost.
Security approves inert Markdown output, link/formula/content handling and no public AI/hidden upload.
Per-PoC environment/evidence freeze and separate human execution authorization.
reopenConditions: A governed Phase 2 task explicitly schedules POC-CONV-004 and fixes deterministic versus OCR scope.
Every required OCR fallback has its own governed disposition; optional AI is not inferred.
All extractor/corpus/oracle/security/resource prerequisites are hash-bound and zero-cost.
An explicit, unexpired human execution authorization is recorded for POC-CONV-004 only.
